messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: staging service 'embedder' returned 15% 503 rate after rolling image r9 -> r10. Auto-bisect suggested r10.

jess_release: Pushing a tiny hotfix build (r10.1) that reverts a header change. Need expedited approval to open a 30m late-window cutover. Impact: <1% traffic, short window.

ana_eng: @jess_release link to the PR?
jess_release: https://git.internal/r/redwood/embedder/PR-842 

kendrick_qe: smoke tests on r10.1 pass locally and on staging smoke harness (cpu mem ok). Ran simple load at 50rps for 5m, no 503s.

ali_sre: what's rollback criteria? if latency >200ms p95 or error rate >1% revert?

jess_release: propose rollback if 503 > 0.5% over 5m or p95 latency up >150ms over baseline. Also keep canary at 5% for 10m then 25% for 10m, then full.

ton y_oncall: typo: @tony_oncall here — I prefer 5% for 15m then 50% for 10m. We had oscillation in EMEA last week.

sam_prod: product signoff: this change fixes a regression seen in a small customer integration — go ahead, expedite approved from PM side.

jess_release: TL;DR checklist:
- pin digest to r10.1 (image sha)
- run pre-deploy smoke (done)
- canary 5% 15m -> 50% 10m -> 100%
- rollback triggers: 503>0.5% 5m OR p95 +150ms
- release note snippet ready

ana_eng: pin sha please
jess_release: image: registry.redwood/embedder@sha256:abcd1234ef567890

kendrick_qe: QA: smoke scripts output:
```
OK  healthcheck  200
OK  embed  sample  tokens  done
```
No regressions in core flow.

deploy-bot: /deploy start --service embedder --image registry.redwood/embedder@sha256:abcd1234ef567890 --canary 5% --canary-duration 15m --rollout-plan 50:10m,100:0m

jess_release: Issuing deploy now. tagging release note: "hotfix: revert header tweak causing 503s in some prefix routing". Anyone object to expedited? say :-1: within 5m.

tony_oncall: no objections but hold at 5% for 15m, watch EU latency. I'll shadow.

ali_sre: I'll watch metrics and prepare revert image (r9 fallback) if triggers hit.

sam_prod: :thumbsup: from product.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY STARTED: embedder r10.1 canary 5% -> started. Deploy ID 2026-0042.

(10m later)

jess_release: quick status: canary 5% for 15m in progress. metrics look clean so far. p95 +10ms, errors 0.03%.

ali_sre: monitoring: EU node had a brief spike to 0.6% 503 at t+7m, auto-alert fired but metric resolved to 0.04% by t+8m. No roll.

tony_oncall: noted. keep observation window 2x on EU for the next 30m.

kendrick_qe: reran negative tests, no increased flakiness.

(15m mark)

deploy-bot: Canary completed: steady-state -> progressing to 50% for 10m per plan.

jess_release: progressing to 50% now. updating release notes: "Hotfix r10.1 rolled to 50% canary. Patch reverts header change causing routing mis-match (partial client SDKs)."

sam_prod: update docs: add note to changelog and ping support on playbook.

ana_eng: sending support note now.

(10m later)

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% success. No rollback triggered.

jess_release: PROD: r10.1 fully live. Rolling release notes to #release-notes and tagging customers impacted.

tony_oncall: good run. leaving note: watch for delayed errors over next 2 hours but OK to close window.

ali_sre: I'll keep dashboards pinned for 2h and will create postmortem if any regression appears.

sam_prod: thanks team. Can someone add the final short blurb for the weekly digest?

jess_release: added: "Hotfix r10.1: header revert -> resolved staging 503 regression; deployed 2026-04-14 UTC; no customer impact observed post-deploy."

kendrick_qe: marking QA check complete.

deploy-bot: NOTE: deploy ID 2026-0042 closed.

jess_release: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
